name: io.github.Xevos117/mcp-zotero
title: MCP Zotero
description: Unofficial Zotero server: search your library, add papers by DOI, import PDFs, cite in Word

environmentVariables.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Zotero Web API key (zotero.org/settings/keys) with library read/write and file access

environmentVariables.name: ZOTERO_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your numeric Zotero user ID (shown on zotero.org/settings/keys); the default library is this user's

environmentVariables.name: ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric group ID; required when ZOTERO_LIBRARY_TYPE is 'group', otherwise defaults to ZOTERO_USER_ID

environmentVariables.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email sent to the Unpaywall API to find open-access PDFs; if unset, OA PDF lookup is skipped

environmentVariables.name: UNSAFE_OPERATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Deletions allowed: 'none' (default, all blocked), 'items' (delete_items) or 'all' (also delete_collection)
